summary: Read owned units s0020–s0028 (Xianhe 9 campaign against Duan Liao's forces). Only births/deaths present are the beheadings of Muti and Siluohou (皆斬之), both captured. No ages are stated. 咸和九年 is Eastern Jin Emperor Cheng's Xianhe 9 (Xianhe 1 = AD 326), conventionally AD 334; year precision only, no month/day so no Julian/Gregorian issue. Units s0022–s0028 carry no new date and inherit Xianhe 9 contextually (旬余, 二旬 give relative order only); the extraction labels these contextual. s0020's alliance is bounded by Hui's death (AD 333) and the Xianhe 9 entry. All 36 owned items and 10 owned people supported.
